column1: Moulder's Travel Guide, 1965 Edition: "No tour of the California good life would be complete without a stop in Lytton...one of those gems of a small town where progress hasn't spoiled the land or the people..."
column2: Moulder 旅遊指南，1965 年版：「加州美好生活之旅若沒在 Lytton 停留，就不算完整……這是一座進步尚未摧毀土地與人民的小鎮瑰寶……」

column1: Western Lifestyles Magazine, May, 1975: "Through the craziness of the '60s, Lytton, California has managed to hang onto its high moral values and simple lifestyle, despite the inevitable encroachment of a few undesirable elements..."
column2: 《西部生活風格》雜誌，1975 年 5 月：「在瘋狂的六○年代，California 的 Lytton 仍設法維持崇高道德與簡樸生活，儘管少數不受歡迎的分子不可避免地逐步侵入……」

column1: Eyes On California, CBC News Report, January, 1985: "Lytton may be a small town geographically, but its problems are at least as serious as those in any major city..."
column2: 「聚焦加州」，CBC 新聞報導，1985 年 1 月：「Lytton 在地理上或許是小鎮，但它的問題至少和任何大城市一樣嚴重……」

column1: Despite the fact that some of these notices are pitifully out of date, you, like everybody else, leave them where they are.
column2: 儘管其中一些公告早已過時得可憐，你和其他人一樣，仍讓它們留在原處。

column1: An announcement: Lytton High School presents "La Boheme," now through the 24th.
column2: 公告：Lytton 高中演出《波希米亞人》，演出至 24 日。

column1: If there's any hope at all of finding this lost cat, you'll ruin it by taking the notice down.
column2: 如果還有任何找回這隻失貓的希望，拿下公告就會毀掉它。

column1: The cabinet doors are kept locked, but you're not missing much. Pushpins, yellow post-its, and other office paraphernalia are kept inside.
column2: 櫃門一直鎖著，但裡面沒什麼值得錯過的東西。裡頭放著圖釘、黃色便利貼和其他辦公雜物。

column1: It's an official Lytton Police Department particle board storage cabinet, Item #42115-54.
column2: 這是 Lytton 警察局的官方塑合板儲藏櫃，物品編號 42115-54。
